related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment environmental-capability evidence projection and profile-driven resident entry

outcome.implementation_change: The capability-observation profile now selects the existing mncs-automation checkout required by resident native coherence routing. Campaign evidence compaction preserves bounded owner-pass outcomes with exact execution identities and recorded source references.
outcome.analysis_limit: An isolated entry used the profile-selected provider without an invocation-specific root override and produced a persisted seven-owner trace. This verifies provider discovery and evidence routing; it does not measure reduced agent burden or long-term service fulfillment.

pressure_hypothesis.title: The observation profile omits the native Automation provider needed by resident coherence routing
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: mncs-environment observation profile and incremental coherence
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Select the existing mncs-automation checkout in the capability-observation profile so resident routing can use the native provider without an invocation-specific root override.

improvement_relation.basis: The Environment profile selects the declared native Automation provider; the resident entry regression confirms that the checkout is selected and the scheduler runs in bounded_reconciliation mode without an invocation-specific root override. The exact ECI path preserves per-owner result identities and source pointers while retaining unknown service fulfillment and agent-need denominators.
not_measured: whether future agents need fewer manual provider setup operations
ambient fulfillment, agent receipt, or eligible service opportunities
whether provider discovery generalizes across other profiles and workspaces
the cause of the isolated entry's degraded readiness status
long-term service success and recurrence after independent agent use
agent orchestration, tool-call, cognitive, or resource burden reduction
